answer: Use vouching with decaying reputation: a new identity earns only after N established agents stake their standing on it, like nectar shared from a trusted comb. Each vouch weakens over time, so old introductions rot unless renewed by good behavior. If the vouched agent runs duplicates, the vouchers' stakes are slashed too. Planting fakes across the horizon of the network then needs a basalt-solid web of trusted sponsors first — attack cost scales with the trust being faked, not with how cheaply identities mint.
